problems: Overlap: Cliopatria's Livonian Conference row (1422-1561, eu-14-f) covers the Order and the four church states written here (bishopric-of-dorpat, bishopric-of-osel-wiek, bishopric-of-courland, archbishopric-of-riga); the 1558 Dorpat loss, the 1559-60 Ösel-Wiek sale and the 1561 end are filed on both sides and one side should carry each. The Order's share should exclude the bishoprics and the Confederation (1435, Walk) should be an association over them.

Overlap: the Swedish and Danish colony dossiers (swedish-livonia, swedish-estonia, swedish-ingria, kexholm-county, swedish-pomerania, bremen-verden, danish-estonia) lie inside Cliopatria's Swedish Empire and Denmark-Norway shapes; they are tints of those and need the parent shape reviewed so the land is not drawn twice.

Date conflicts between pages: Ösel-Wiek (26 September 1559 treaty vs 15 April 1560 possession vs the Conference dossier's 1559-9 loss); Courland (1559, 20 May 1560, 20 April 1562, 20 April 1585); Riga free imperial city 1561 vs 1562; Courland partition 1253 (bishopric page) vs 1266 (Curonians page); Christburg 1249 vs 1253; Ingria 1590 vs 1595; Dorpat May vs July 1558 (Livonian War footnote).

Counterpart naming in sibling dossiers: swedish-pomerania names duchy-of-pomerania as occupier where another dossier says swedish-empire; denmark-norway files its Ösel and Bremen-Verden events under swedish-empire.
bremen-verden has one validator warning: its Torstenson War (1643-1645) precedes the state's 1648 start; kept because the Bremen-Verden page dates the war.

Placements from outside the gazetteer or pages: Mölln and Bergedorf circle centres, the Kexholm polygon and the Dithmarschen cut are the researcher's approximations (flagged in region texts, certainty soft); Archbishopric of Riga and Courland are equal-area stand-ins.
free-imperial-city-of-lubeck continues as eu-20-a's free-city-of-lubeck (same state, one colour) and county-of-holstein continues as an uncovered duchy-of-holstein 1474-1848.
